note: Founded 2024 by Benjamin Swerdlow (CEO) and Jacob Zwang (CTO), both ex-Apple Senior Engineers (Conversational Engineering team). San Francisco-based. Launched publicly on Hacker News (Launch HN: Freestyle – Sandboxes for Coding Agents, April 2026) pivoting from an earlier 'fullstack TypeScript cloud/cloudstate' framework to bare-metal VM sandboxes for AI coding agents, running on their own bare-metal racks. YC page confirms same domain (freestyle.sh) and batch S24, Active status. No funding amount, round type, investors, or revenue could be confirmed or estimated from credible sources within the research window; flagged as unknown rather than guessed.
